shots.focal_element: A cursor-guided tour across several Apollo screens: sequence overview with A/B test, email template editor with the AI assistant menu, the Home control center (stat cards, Workstreams tabs, Tasks table), a 'Book a meeting with Alex' scheduling page, and a Google Calendar event with the Apollo side panel
shots.typography: Native product UI only: small neo-grotesk sans, regular weight body, semibold card titles and stat numerals, sentence case, normal tracking; no added motion-graphics type in this shot. Font guess (low confidence): Inter-like.
shots.what_happens: Long continuous walkthrough synced to the VO (w167-w253). On 'utilize A-B testing' (w167-w170) the cursor hovers and clicks 'Add A/B Test' in the sequence overview; on 'and A-I to optimize your outreach' (w171-w184) the row menu opens Edit, the template editor appears with a preview pane, and the AI assistant menu (Generate email, Personalize email, Rephrase selection) opens. On 'Next, the Home tab' (w185-w188) the cursor clicks Home and the camera pushes in on the control center stat cards and Workstreams; the cursor steps across Recent replies, Recommended prospects and Tasks in time with 'who to respond to, who to target next, and what tasks' (w197-w213). The view then zooms tighter onto the Tasks table (about 1:11.5-1:14.5) with the cursor hovering the email action on the first row during w214-w222, then pulls back out. On 'leverage meetings' (w230-w231) the cursor clicks Meetings and a horizontal slide reveals a 'Book a meeting with Alex' page; a date and 10:00 AM time are picked, Confirm is clicked and the Enter details form appears (w232-w238). Around 1:20.5 (w239-w241) the page shrinks into a rounded card over a brand-yellow background with lighter circles, then a Google Calendar event popup slides in on that yellow stage and scales up to full frame by 1:23.0; on 'before and after every meeting' (w246-w250) the cursor clicks inside the event and the Apollo Chrome-extension side panel slides in from the right. Exact easing is not visible at 2 fps.
shots.build_rebuild: Composite a sequence of separately recorded product screens on one timeline, driving a virtual camera (scale/translate push-ins and pull-backs) per VO phrase, joining screens with horizontal slides, and for the meetings beat scale the full-frame page down into a rounded shadowed card over a yellow brand background with soft circles before scaling the next screen (calendar) back up to full frame.
